name: Daidai — Exact-Out Invoice Agent
description: Daidai is a prototype for exact-amount stablecoin invoice settlement on Celo. It prepares a USDt-to-cNGN conversion through Textile FX, checks the invoice amount and spend cap, and prepares a separate cNGN payout for human approval. Daidai has no public service endpoint or demonstrated mainnet invoice settlement.
